overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the process number of the frontmost window; without the optional * parameter this checks the floating-window layer when called from a floating window's method, otherwise the regular window layer, while passing * always returns the frontmost active window of the regular (non-floating) layer.

discriminatedBy.rule: presence of the literal '*' forces the result to the regular (non-floating) window layer instead of the layer implied by the calling context
